The plan addresses integrating the OOT (Outfit Of Today) persona and knowledge base into the AI chat system. Key changes:

**8 Step-by-Step Tasks:**
1. Create OOT Persona Module (`oot-persona.ts`) - exports personality traits, Thai-English code-switching phrases, and tone examples
2. Create Knowledge Base Summaries Module (`fashion-summaries.ts`) - consolidates fashion expertise for AI context
3. Update System Prompt v2 - replace formal customer service tone with bestie personality
4. Update System Prompt v3 - enhance Friend Mode with full persona integration
5. Integrate Knowledge Base into AI Chat Service - inject relevant fashion knowledge into responses
6. Update Response Templates - match chat dialog mockup format
7. Add OOT Boundaries and Emergency Responses - handle sensitive situations gracefully
8. Validate and Test - ensure compilation and lint pass
